svg.title: AI Business Strategy and Transformation Whiteboard
svg.desc: An internal planning canvas connecting capability learning phases P0 to P7 with enterprise transformation stages T0 to T7, cross-cutting rails, decision gates, management evidence, and next decisions.
svg.text: NORTH STAR · PLANNING TARGET — NOT A PROVEN OUTCOME
Introduce responsible AI to create measurable business value, improve selected processes,

text.tspan: Which business problems should AI help solve?
Which process and decision are affected?
What evidence would justify GO, ADAPT, HOLD, or STOP?

svg.text: DECISION GATE — APPLY AT EVERY PHASE

text.tspan: GO — evidence supports only the named next step.
ADAPT — route remains valid; scope, method, or artifact changes.
HOLD — owner, evidence, specialist review, or prerequisite is missing.
STOP — problem, method, or route is not viable within acceptable limits.
Big picture first; zoom for evidence detail.
HTML: wheel/pinch to zoom; drag to pan; click a phase to inspect.
Use phase selector or keyboard arrows; 0 resets the canvas.

text.tspan: P5 makes T5 review and adoption gates
P6 enables an evidence-based T6 decision.
CURRENT EVIDENCE BASELINE — Strategy and sample artifacts may exist. Customer discovery,
willingness to pay, a real baseline, value proof, technical feasibility, specialist approval, and
scale readiness remain unproven unless evidenced.
RECOMMENDED NEXT DEPENDENCY — Deepen the earliest unresolved business-problem and value-lever
evidence before advancing to attractive tools or scaling.
DECISION OWNERS — Executive sponsor; business process owner; AI/transformation lead;
legal/privacy/security/labour specialists; finance/value owner; technology feasibility owner.
OPEN DECISIONS — Target segment; priority process; intended access/delivery; evidence source; pilot
STATUS RULE — Reviews required; no approval assumed. Repeatability is not production readiness.

svg.text: CROSS-CUTTING RAILS · RUN THROUGH EVERY PHASE

text.tspan: Outcome → baseline → target hypothesis → measurement → decision.
Stakeholder impact → participation → capability → adoption → feedback.
Legal · privacy · information security · labour law / works council · data rights · technical feasibility. REVIEWS REQUIRED; NO APPROVAL ASSUMED.
Facts | assumptions & data gaps | options & trade-offs | risks & dependencies | recommendation & decision owner.

svg.text: EVIDENCE ZONE · COMPLETE BEFORE THE NEXT DECISION

text.tspan: What are we treating as true?
Which gap could reverse the decision?
Which owner or prerequisite is missing?
Named decision owner and next step?
What evidence is still not proven?

svg.text: INTERNAL PLANNING AID · No legal, privacy, security, labour, technical, or production approval is implied.
